title: Cable Fly
summary: A cable fly that keeps tension on the chest through a big stretch.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.3 for front delts (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Set the pulleys at chest height or a little higher and take one handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide hugging arc.
Open back out slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

form_cues.cue: Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows
Open wide to a deep chest stretch
Bring hands together in a hugging arc
Keep the elbow bend fixed. This is a hug, not a press.

mistakes.text: Bending and straightening the elbows so it turns into a press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Less constant tension.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus, Less constant tension.
